customer.business: ShotDomain, a web app that screenshots every page of a website on desktop, tablet and phone, and can re-capture and compare them on a schedule
customer.target: Freelance web designers/developers, small web agency owners and in-house web/QA staff who need screenshots of whole client or company websites
customer.where: online, worldwide (English-speaking; many freelancers in lower-cost countries)

segments.name: Small web agency owner or project manager (2-15 people)
In-house marketing, web or QA staff at a company

behaviours.name: Does it by hand today
behaviours.how: Screenshots pages one by one with a browser extension when a project needs it.

behaviours.name: Would script it
behaviours.how: Comfortable writing a quick Playwright or Puppeteer script rather than paying for a tool.

behaviours.name: Already pays for a monitoring tool
behaviours.how: Uses a change-monitoring or screenshot-archive service for a few key pages.

behaviours.name: Lifetime-deal hunter
behaviours.how: Buys tools on AppSumo-style one-time deals and avoids new subscriptions.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Will not try a new tool without reviews, a free tier and proof it works on real sites.

behaviours.name: Tight budget
behaviours.how: Every subscription is weighed against what clients pay; cancels anything unused for a month.

behaviours.name: Client reporting focused
behaviours.how: Sends clients before/after evidence and reports; wants things that look professional.

objections: I only need full-site screenshots a few times a year, not every month
A free browser extension already does full-page screenshots
I could script this myself in an afternoon
Will it actually work on my clients' sites with bot protection, logins and cookie banners?
It is brand new with no reviews; will it still be around next year?
I don't want to give a third-party tool my clients' login sessions
Change alerts from tools like this are usually noisy and full of false positives
habits: you hand over a redesigned site to a client roughly once a month
you check sites on your phone because most of your clients' visitors are on mobile
you keep a folder of before/after screenshots for your portfolio
you already pay for Figma, a hosting account and a password manager
your clients sometimes ask 'what did the site look like before?' and you can't answer

pitch:
ShotDomain, a new web app (launching soon; no reviews yet).
Paste a website address: it finds every page (from the sitemap or by following links) and screenshots them all, full page, on desktop, tablet, iPhone and Android in one run. Download a ZIP or share a link.
It can re-capture chosen pages daily, weekly or monthly, compare each page with the last run and email you when something changes. It can also capture pages behind a login if you paste your browser session (no password needed).
Free: 15 pages per capture, desktop only. Studio: $9/month or $90/year (150 pages per capture, all devices, pages behind a login, 5 schedules of 25 pages). Agency: $29/month or $290/year (500 pages, 25 schedules of 100 pages). Lifetime: $99 once for Studio.
Sign in with Google. 14-day money-back guarantee. Never bypasses CAPTCHAs or bot protection.
